starting-out-trying-to-trade-ava.speaker: Ava
starting-out-trying-to-trade-ava.text: Hello there, I'm busy with my research. Come back in a bit, could you?

starting-out-talking-to-ava.speaker: Ava
starting-out-talking-to-ava.text: Hello there and welcome to my humble abode. It's sadly rather more humble than I'd like, to be honest, although perhaps you can help with that?

options.text: I would be happy to make your home a better place.

steps.player: I would be happy to make your home a better place.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Yay, I didn't even have to talk about a reward; you're more gullible than most adventurers, that's for sure.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Don't worry, though; I just need you to help fix this vile old bed for me. Then I'll find a suitable reward for you.

steps.player: Great, will I be able to take a nap in it?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Don't be silly; everyone knows that true warriors don't ever sleep...or perform many other bodily functions, for that matter. I'll come up with something, though.

steps.player: I'm not convinced by just a vague something; can you be a slight bit more inspiring in your offer?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: What I need is simple: a couple of undead chickens. You should be able to pick some up at the farm near Port Phasmatys. I'll use one for my bed, then see what I can make from the other in the way of a reward. I have some ideas involving infinite feathers.

steps.player: Very well then, I shall await my mystery prize with bated breath.

options.text: I'm not much into interior design, to tell the truth.

steps.player: I'm not much into interior design, to tell the truth.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Very well, I suppose I'll just have to resort to the Professor's patented sleeping aid in order to get some rest. It does so bruise my head, though.

options.text: What's a nice girl like you doing in a place like this?

steps.player: What's a nice girl like you doing in a place like this?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: I'm not a nice girl. I'm a respectable scientist researching the interactions between ghosts and the force of pure science.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: I took over the position of assistant to the Professor upstairs, although, to be honest, his methods are somewhat eccentric. Did you head about the Ernest scandal?

steps.player: Ah, yes. I helped sort that out; he did seem a bit odd.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: You don't know the half of it - can you believe that he thinks he has proven Goldbach's First Conjecture using an optimised segmented sieve?

steps.player: Er, quite, Yes.

starting-out-talking-to-ava-again.speaker: Ava
starting-out-talking-to-ava-again.text: Do you need a reminder what you are supposed to do? I know you must have shiny beads distracting you, but it is an important job you are doing for me.

steps.player: Yes, please.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: ...And people say we scientists are absent minded...

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: You need to fetch 2 undead chickens for me to use in my redecoration. It's not rocket science.

steps.player: Rocket?

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: If they existed, they would be like arrows but much, much bigger. Considering the mess you rangers make with small bits of stick, we scientists have decided they don't exist. Now get chicken hunting.

options.text: No, thank you, I just came to gossip with you.

steps.player: No thank you; I just came to gossip with you.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Well, the Witch next door has been cooking some rather nice gingerbread, but I don't think that counts as gossip.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: Can you head off and do adventurous stuff, please? I hear the Wilderness is fun this time of year.

starting-out-using-items-on-ava-feather.speaker: Ava
starting-out-using-items-on-ava-feather.text: What are you doing? I'm not ticklish.

starting-out-using-items-on-ava-raw-chic.speaker: Ava
starting-out-using-items-on-ava-raw-chic.text: What are you doing? Yuck, dead things.

starting-out-using-items-on-ava-cooked-c.speaker: Ava
starting-out-using-items-on-ava-cooked-c.text: What are you doing? Do I look that thin?

starting-out-using-items-on-ava-raw-chic.speaker: Ava
starting-out-using-items-on-ava-raw-chic.text: What are you doing? Trying to infect me with some vile disease?

starting-out-using-items-on-ava-other-it.speaker: Ava
starting-out-using-items-on-ava-other-it.text: I'm not sure what you are trying to do, are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.player: I'm here about a quest.
I am after one of your, er, unhealthier poultry. Could you help me?

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: You need those useless, undead chickens? How odd you adventurers are.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: You need to talk to my husband, though - not that I can these days.

steps.player: Whyever would this be?

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: Can't you see, he is dead. I can't talk to the dead.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Without the Ghostspeak amulet equipped:

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Woo woo!
With the Ghostspeak amulet equipped:

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: Your animals don't look too healthy.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: I do miss the wife though; tell 'er I still loves her.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: Would I be able to buy some of your chickens?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Talk to my wife and I'll think about it.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: 'Ave you talked to my wife for me?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: Not yet; I've been distracted by the thought of undead cow milk.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.player: I'm here about a quest.
I have a message from your husband. He wants you to know that he still loves you, despite his ghostly state.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: The curse of undeath was so cruel; all the men out here succumbed, but Lyra and I were left alive.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: Tell him I love him but I can't find our savings. I know he had our collection of gold and 'prize cow' rosettes just before the curse struck.

steps.player: I'll have a word with him, then; magic has its uses I suppose.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Have you spoken to my husband yet?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: Your wife says she needs the family cash and wants to know what you did with it.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Tell 'er I spent it on cheap spirits, har har.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: Your sense of humour died too, it seems...

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Hah, just trying to lift your spirits.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Suit yerself, stick-in-the-mud. Anyway, Oim not one o' them yokels. Tell 'er I putted the cash in the bank like she always told me to.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: A warning to ya, too: annoy her and I'll haunt ya till yer hair turns white.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Any luck wiv me wife?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.player: I'm here about that quest.
Your husband says he put the cash in the bank.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: I'll need his bank pass, in that case.

steps.player: Can't you just take a ghostspeak amulet? Then you could talk to him directly.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: I tried that once, but all those other ghosts - and even the undead chickens and cows - scared me so much. I wouldn't try it again for all the cash in Varrock bank.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Have you asked him about the bank pass?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: You may not believe me, but she wants me to find your bank pass now.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Maybe she said that, maybe she didn't. I think you're just after me savings. Tell 'er that no one but a fool gives away their pass numbers.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Go tell 'er now, if you're not a double-dealin' scammer, that is.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: 'Ave you talked to 'er?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Hello. How can I help you?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

steps.player: I'm here about that quest.
He says he won't trust me with the bank pass.
What if I gave some sort of altered ghostspeak amulet to him - surely that would work?

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: You're so clever; I've overheard passing adventurers say that there's some witch near here who changes ghostspeak amulets.

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: I think she lives a bit west of that mad Professor Fenksomething, past the Farming patch.

steps.player: I'll see if I can find her. Big nose and a monstrous hat, I assume? I wonder where the beautiful young witches hide...

steps.speaker: Alice
steps.text: Mysterious indeed, but in this case she actually looks pretty normal.

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.text: Have you found a way for me to talk to my husband yet?

the-alive-undead-chickens-the-problem-a-.player: I've not progressed at all, I'm afraid.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Alice and her husband are having trouble talking to one another and said you might be able to help.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: Ah, I know them; shame about those cows. Why would they think that I could help?

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: Alice seems to think you could alter a ghostspeak amulet in order to allow them to communicate.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: If the player has completed Ghosts Ahoy:

steps.player: In addition, when I was attempting to thwart Necrovarus, you created a new type of amulet for me. I thought that perhaps you might also do so on this occasion.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: Well, the poor young lady has such family problems; I quite feel her pain. I'd be happy to help.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: You seem to have one of her golden hairs on your shoulder, so I can use that...
In a flash, the crone whisks away an unseen hair from your shoulder.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: Talk to me again with a ghostspeak amulet and some space in your backpack and I'll be ready to work on this little good deed. The way I plan is quite simple, really.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: I can mirror part of the unused mystical essence of the ghostspeak amulet, bind it with Alice's hair and thus create a second amulet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: The second amulet will be useful for the purpose you desire, though it won't work for any other ghost or human other than the farmer and his wife.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
I'm here to see if you are ready to do your mystical stuff with my ghostspeak amulet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: I most certainly am, but you don't have an ghostspeak amulet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
I'm here to see if you are ready to do your mystical stuff with my ghostspeak amulet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: I most certainly am, but you don't have space in your backpack.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
I'm here to see if you are ready to do your mystical stuff with my ghostspeak amulet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: I most certainly am; there you go.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: Wow, that was quick and painless.
I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Would you be able to replace the amulet you made? I seem to have lost it.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: Here you are; lucklily, I saved some of Alice's hair in case you were careless. Which you were.

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.player: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Well, to tell the truth, I just came back to chat with you. Any news?

the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.speaker: Old Crone
the-alive-undead-chickens-obtaining-the-.text: Disgraceful! Deliver that amulet; a young lady's happiness depends upon it.
Your ghostliness isn't ethereal enough to wear this.
Perhaps you should wait a few hundred years or so?

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Have you handed him an enhanced amulet?

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.player: I have obtained the amulet; I just haven't handed it over yet. So, it's looking good!
I talked to your wife and thought that if you had a special amulet, you could speak to her and sort out the bank situation without me being involved.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Arr, that makes far more sense than I was expecting from a muscle-head like you. My wife's a clever one.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.player: Well... oh, never mind. I'm desperate enough for those chickens to let that pass.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Give me that amulet, then, and we'll be seeing about your unnatural desire for chickens.

options.text: Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.

steps.player: Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: Ta, mate.

steps.player: Lucky we had such a brilliant idea.

options.text: I don't think I'm ready to hand it over yet.

steps.player: I don't think I'm ready to hand it over yet.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Ahhh, many thanks. Now what was it you were wanting again?

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.player: I need a couple of your chickens.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Chickens is tricksy, 'specially dead 'uns. I'll have to catch 'em for ye.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.player: They look pretty pathetic; how hard can it be?

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Stand back while I catches 'em, ya city slicker.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: You heard my husband: leave now!

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Cow31337Killer
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Always the same; I can never get these animals to myself.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Cow31337Killer
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Buying cowhides and feathers - ahh, that chicken is next; feathers for me!

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.player: Well, that's one way to catch a chicken, I suppose.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Malcolm
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Hello, how can I help you? I'm sellin' if you have ecto- tokens.

options.text: Could I buy those chickens now, then?

steps.player: Could I buy those chickens now?

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: I can hand over a chicken if you give me 10 of them ecto-token thingies per bird.
one Undead chicken

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: Ta, some day soon I'll be havin' a nice undead bed to kip in.
two Undead chicken

steps.player: Could I buy 2 chickens?

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: Great! I'm laying away me tokens for some killer cows. That'll learn them bone rustlers.

options.text: Your animals don't look too healthy; I'll buy elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: Har har, how many ghost chicky farmers d'you know, den?

options.text: Your animals don't look too healthy.

steps.player: Your animals don't look too healthy.

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.

steps.player: What use are zombie animals?

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.

steps.player: But you're a ghost - surely you know something about it.

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.

steps.player: I'm okay, thank you.

options.text: Where can I get these ecto-tokens?

steps.speaker: Malcolm
steps.text: The ghosts I talk to say that the tokens have something to do with the tower just east of here. If you need to collect some I'd try there.

the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.speaker: Alice
the-alive-undead-chickens-returning-to-a.text: Hello, friend, and thanks for allowing me to talk to my husband Malcolm. How can I help you?

options.text: Can you give me any Farming advice?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: My spiritometric devices show that you have been in close contact with ghostly animals. Are we closer to success?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: Amazing! Success! I can look forward to some good nights' sleep after all.

magnetism-the-next-task.player: Can I ask exactly how an undead chicken will help you sleep?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: Well, I need the feathers to make my bed more comfortable. A comfortable bed will help me sleep. Obvious, really.

magnetism-the-next-task.player: Obvious, yes, but why on Gielinor would you need an undead chicken when there are perfectly good live chickens just down the road?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: Well, for a start, undead feathers are much cleaner than living ones; no dust mites or anything. Secondly, I always think of Ernest when I see a chicken, so my nerves can't take killing them.

magnetism-the-next-task.player: Then why do I need a chicken for my reward; we already established that I don't use a bed?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: Seeing as how you ranger types use so many feathers in your arrows, I was thinking I could harness an undead chicken to make an unending supply of arrow flights for you.

magnetism-the-next-task.player: Beats chicken slaying or hanging around in fishing shops, I suppose. So, what next?

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: We'll need a magnet next, one with purely natural fields and made from a carefully selected iron bar. A firm impact when the iron is parallel to Gielinor's field will stabilise this field in the rod.

magnetism-the-next-task.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task.text: Go and talk to the Witch next door.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: My spiritometric devices show that you have been in close contact with ghostly animals. Are we closer to success?

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.player: Well, I can buy the ones you want but I don't have any on me.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: Stunning. I should have tried to hire some gnomes instead. They may be obsessed with their bellies but they can at least be trusted to deliver unpleasant perishables.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: My spiritometric devices show that you have been in close contact with ghostly animals. Are we closer to success?

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.player: Well, I have this one which I can use to club people.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: Are you going to hand it over or do you want to continue to waft it about menacingly?

options.text: I prefer to keep this fine weapon with which to smite mine enemies.

steps.player: I prefer to keep this fine weapon with which to smite mine enemies.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: You would be more menacing if your weapon weren't quite so rotten.

options.text: You can take it; it smells anyway.

steps.player: You can take it; it smells anyway.

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: On second thought, the way you wave it about makes me fear for my life. Stow it in your back and talk to me again.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: My spiritometric devices show that you have been in close contact with ghostly animals. Are we closer to success?

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: Thanks! This is great for me, although I'll need another one if you want any sort of reward.

magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-speaking-to-ava-.text: Why do you come back with no chickens? I'll be needing another one before I give you your reward! I'm not going to relent, even if you say 'plz plz plz' and claim you were just scammed.

magnetism-the-next-task-handing-over-the.player: Here's the second one for my reward.

magnetism-the-next-task-handing-over-the.text: Continues with Ava's Amazing! Success! dialogue

magnetism-the-next-task-talking-to-ava-a.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-talking-to-ava-a.text: Go and talk to the Witch next door. She'd talk the hid legs off a donkey but she can select the iron with which is suitable for the chicken to interact.

magnetism-the-next-task-talking-to-ava-a.speaker: Ava
magnetism-the-next-task-talking-to-ava-a.text: Despite my extensive studies, her years of experience make her better at instinctive magico-mystical interaction. Oh well, at least I'm cleverer, prettier and will have a better bed.

magnetism-the-next-task-talking-to-ava-a.player: Okay, okay, you're great. Yes, I'll go and talk to her when you've finished praising yourself.

magnetism-helpful-witch.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch.text: Hello, hello, my poppet. What brings you to my little room?

magnetism-helpful-witch.player: Ava told me to ask you about making magnets. Something about natural fields and other stuff. Sounded like she needed a farmer, to be honest.

magnetism-helpful-witch.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch.text: Don't worry, deary, I can tell you just what to do and you won't have to worry your pretty head about the complicated bits.

magnetism-helpful-witch.player: No need to patronise me quite so much, you know.

magnetism-helpful-witch.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch.text: I went to anger management classes, my lambkin; that's why I was treating you so kindly. It's either this way of talking or I'll go back to shoving children into ovens.

magnetism-helpful-witch.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch.text: Just bring me 5 iron bars, though, and you're well on the way to never having to talk to me again.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Oh, but sugarpie, I need 5 iron bars, you don't have any. Come back to me quickly with all 5 of them.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.player: I have some iron bars here.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Oh, but sugarpie, I need 5 iron bars, you don't have enough. Come back to me quickly with all 5 of them.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.player: I've talked to the Witch and she has asked me for some iron bars.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.speaker: Ava
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.text: Do I resemble an iron-bar merchant?

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.player: Er, maybe; I've never met one.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.speaker: Ava
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.text: An entirely logical answer; you'll make a scientist yet.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Great, you'll go far! I made some nice painted metal toys for you, snookums.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.player: Toys? Snookums? What are you on about, you deranged old bat?

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Oh, forget it, then. If you won't react to kindness, I'm back to luring infants into my oven. You'll have it on your conscience.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Go to the iron mine just north-east of Rimmington and hit the bar with a plain old smithing hammer while facing north. Then take your new magnet to Ava. Poor girl, having to deal with whippersnappers like you.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: I can't say that I didn't expect this; you'd lose your head if it weren't glued on. Lucky I made some replacements. Take this one and leave me in peace.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: You were sent to try my patience, weren't you? Go away and make that magnet, then hand it to Ava.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.player: I've talked to the Witch and now I've given her some iron bars.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.speaker: Ava
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.text: I'm thrilled for you. What about my magnet?

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.player: The process is subject to some unexpected delays.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.speaker: Ava
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-ava-b.text: I can see now why Fenkenstain prefers to work with dead folk. It can't be more frustrating than working with you.

magnetism-helpful-witch-using-hammer-on-.text: You aren't in the the right area for this to work.
You think that facing North might work better.
You hammer the iron bar and create a magnet.

magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.speaker: Witch
magnetism-helpful-witch-talking-to-the-w.text: Hoorah for you, you have the magnet. Just hand it over to Ava. I'm working on my new recipe for spit-roast adventurer, so disturbing me isn't wise.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.player: I've manufactured the magnet; here it is.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: Great stuff! With the Witch's influence within the magnet, the undead chicken can use this, I'm sure.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: The plan is that the chicken will operate the magnet to attract bits of iron and steel, maybe even your own recently fired arrows. There are plenty of totally lost arrowheads lying about in the fields of Gielinor, I bet.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: In addition, arrows which you fire should be able to be attracted back to your quiver by the cunning avian.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.player: I begin to understand your plan. We've covered feathers and arrowheads now; what next?

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: We need a source of wood, but one which is spiritually active and can regenerate itself. That will save you some axework in the future.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: Try using a woodcutting axe on the pesky trees in the garden here, the ones that attack rather than the really dead ones. They are probably just the sort of thing we could use.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.player: They will try to kill me, though, and I can't fight back!

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: Now you know how those poor guards feel when you hide behind mushrooms and fences and attack them from afar! Anyway, I reckon you'll need to try a mithril or better axe on the trees. At least the trees are

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: So, what terrible hitch have you encountered now?

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.player: Nothing really; I just decided to talk to you in case you have any great advice for me.

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: Well, I've heard that all kinds of dragons and even basilisks can drop mithril axes, if that's why you are delaying. Most of these creatures are silly enough that you can even hide behind something and plink them to

the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-handing-the-magnet-to-.text: death in the brave ranger way.
You don't have an axe which could possibly affect this wood.
The axe bounces off the undead wood. You should report this to Ava.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: If While Guthix Sleeps has been completed, then Aya replaces Turael, with the same dialogue as Turael.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.player: Well, I tried to hack the trees with my axe, but it just bounced off the trunk! It did all seem all-too-convenient to work on the first try.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: Fortunately for you, I've done some research and it seems to suggest that there are two choices open to you.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: The first is more interesting. We cut off your arms, have them reanimated as undead, reattach them and then you should be able to cut the trees normally.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: Of course, you won't be able to pick your nose anymore, so I suppose you'll want to try the second option.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.player: I'm not exactly addicted to picking my nose, but I do think I'll pass on that method.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: Well, in that case, I think it may have something to do with Slayer abilities. After all, I did see [Turael/Aya] poking around the trees while I was moving in.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.text: As [he's/she's] not known for [his/her] random touristic activities, you should try chatting with this [Turael/Aya]. [He's/She's] the Slayer Master near Burthorpe.

the-bark-has-bite-returning-to-ava.player: Oh dear, I hope [he/she] doesn't want me to buy one of [his/her] ridiculous fashion accessories. Those earmuffs [he/she] sells make heroic adventurers into a laughing stock.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.speaker: Turael
the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: I'm here about a quest. Ava said she saw you hanging around the moving trees near Draynor Manor.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Ahh, you came to the right man; odd things, those trees. What is it you are needing exactly?

steps.player: I think I need some of the wood from them, but my axe just bounced off the trunk.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Sounds like you need a blessed axe. No one really makes them, though, these days.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: Blessed axes are too soft to cut normal wood since the axe's edge must be replaced by holy silver. I can do you a favour, though.

steps.speaker: Turael
steps.text: If you can give me a mithril axe and a holy symbol of Saradomin I can let you have my axe. I'll make myself a new one when no one is pestering me for Slayer tasks.

steps.player: Okay, so I'll see whether I can spare an axe and a symbol. Thanks.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.speaker: Aya
the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: I'm here about a quest. Ava said she saw you hanging around the moving trees near Draynor Manor.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: Ahh, you came to the right man; odd things, those trees. What is it you are needing exactly?

steps.player: I think I need some of the wood from them, but my axe just bounced off the trunk.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: Sounds like you need a blessed axe. No one really makes them, though, these days.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: Blessed axes are too soft to cut normal wood since the axe's edge must be replaced by holy silver. I can do you a favour, though.

steps.speaker: Aya
steps.text: If you can give me a mithril axe and a holy symbol of Saradomin I can let you have my axe. I'll make myself a new one when no one is pestering me for Slayer tasks.

steps.player: Okay, so I'll see whether I can spare an axe and a symbol. Thanks.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.speaker: Turael/Aya
the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.text: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
Hello, I'm here about those trees again.

steps.player: Hello, I'm here about those trees again.

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: I can make an axe for you now, if you wish. Remember, it will be no use for normal woodcutting after I have added the silver edge.
If the player has both holy symbol and mithril axe:

steps.player: I'd love one, thanks.

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: Here's a new axe; may it serve you well.
If the player only has a mithril axe:

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have a symbol in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
If the player only has a holy symbol:

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
If the player has neither axe nor holy symbol:

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.speaker: Turael/Aya
steps.text: Goodbye then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.player: [Turael/Aya], the Slayer Master, told me what to do - with no earmuffs, spiky helmets or other laughable headgear involved.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.text: A pity; you'd look quite cute with rabbit ears. Perhaps I should have bribed [him/her].

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.player: I think I'm ready to cut those trees now.

the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.speaker: Ava
the-bark-has-bite-a-slayer-s-perspective.text: What do you want? A prize? Go and get the wood; it's not as if the trees are wandering about and hard to find.
You almoust remove a suitable twig, but you don't quite manage it.

research-and-development-delivering-the-.player: I have that undead wood at last. Well, twigs anyway.
I'd say they didn't grow on trees, but I guess you'd just be sarcastic about my sense of humour.

research-and-development-delivering-the-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-delivering-the-.text: Quite. Now that we have all the ingredients for infinite arrows, we just need a container in which we can keep the components in the correct mutual alignment.

research-and-development-delivering-the-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-delivering-the-.text: I've gathered together some research notes from various sources but I can't quite make out what they mean. If you want to have a go at making them out, just ask me for a copy.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.player: I'd like to look at those research notes now, unless you have translated them without me?

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.text: They are still stumping me. Here are the notes; I really hope your head doesn't explode from reading them.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.player: I'd find it slightly inconvenient, I'm sure.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.text: It wouldn't be all bad as your body would be useful for research after death. What I'd be upset about was if bits of you landed in my nice new bed.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.player: I seem to have lost the research notes.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.text: Don't tell me, your cat ate them? You won't get out of the job that easily; here are some copies I made.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.player: I have the notes but haven't translated them yet. Any hints?

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.text: I know you have the notes; I gave them to you, in case you forgot. Furthermore, if I had hints, I'd have translated those notes myself.

research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.speaker: Ava
research-and-development-talking-to-ava-.text: So, take the hint and go off and translate them. If it's too hard, you can always go and shoot demons in cages.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: I've translated those notes. See? I'm not just a thuggish moron like you seem to think.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: For all I know, it was pure luck, so don't jump to any conclusions about your mighty intellect.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: I can see why you don't have any assistants; you're not exactly easy to work with.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: Let's get back to the work we're doing, then. Remember, this is all a favour to you; I could have just decided to fob you off with a feather duster.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: I've given you a pattern for the container; you'll need to combine them with some polished buttons and hard leather. Then we're almost done. Good news, eh?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: If you are having trouble finding buttons, I've heard rumours that the H.A.M. society carry this sort of stuff more than most.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: Really? How would you know this strange detail?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: I hear they lose their clothes a lot to thieves so they have to make do with shoddy goods. Whatever the reason, they seem to carry buttons about in their pockets.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: So what do I do with this pattern again?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: Your short-term memory loss worries me.  Combine the pattern with hard leather and some polished buttons, then hand the resulting container to me.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: The pattern seems to have vanished from my pack... not my fault, of course.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: You're pretty careless, aren't you? I assume you're the type who leaves a trail of arrows and knives behind them when they train?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: Here's a replacement; perhaps if I charged for them, you'd be more careful.
You need a pattern as well as these 2 items.
You need hard leather as well as these 2 items.
You need polished buttons as well as these 2 items.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: You've made the container, I assume?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: Well, yes, although I seem to have mislaid it.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: It's only the final, vital step in your quest that you decided to leave who-knows-where. Don't worry, I have plenty of spares.

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.player: Why do I sense sarcasm somewhere here?

the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-handing-in-the-notes.text: You've made one container; surely you can make another. Is it killing a cow or spotting those bright pink H.A.M. members that you are having troubles with?

the-final-component-delivering-the-conta.speaker: Ava
the-final-component-delivering-the-conta.text: Wow, great, now the arrow manufacturer is ready for use...there you are! Talk to me if you need more information later.
If the player has level 50 Ranged:

steps.speaker: Ava
steps.text: You are also skilled enough that I'm rewarding you with the upgraded version right away. Congratulations.
